# Sunday designs

The working list is [the Sunday plan](../PLAN.md). A design file is written only when its boxes there are being ticked. A test starts only after that file's boxes are ticked.

The WhatsApp page is not a Sunday design. [The Saturday handoff](../../2026-10-31/design/whatsapp-simulator-handoff.md) names the files that builder may edit.

| File | Artifact | Block |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [approve-exception.md](approve-exception.md) | Approve, reject, the queue, the audit timeline | A |
| [frameworks-decide.md](frameworks-decide.md) | FrameWorks predicates on the existing `decide` | B |
| [policy-publish.md](policy-publish.md) | `validate_policy`, draft, publish, rollback | B |
| [rate-card-import.md](rate-card-import.md) | Excel into a draft | C |
